message: BGP route withdrawal detected: ALL prefixes withdrawn from global BGP table. 0 routes announced. DNS-svc unreachable from external networks. BGPRouteMonitor: no active peers. Backbone routers lost connectivity to all edge PoPs at 15:39:54Z.

DNS resolution completely failed: company.com NXDOMAIN globally. Root cause: BGP prefix withdrawal made authoritative DNS servers unreachable from internet. 2.9 billion users affected. Internal tools also down — internal DNS routed through same backbone.

Configuration audit commands sent to backbone routers during maintenance triggered unintended route withdrawal side effect. BGP session peers: 0 active (was: 24). All traffic blackholed. Engineers unable to access network tools remotely — internal systems also unreachable.

Physical datacenter access required for manual BGP restore. Remote remediation tools unavailable. Engineers dispatched to Santa Clara datacenter. ETA 20 minutes. No remote fix path — SSH/VPN also routed through affected backbone.

BGP routes restored after 6h32m. Manual router reconfiguration at datacenter. BGP peers: 24/24 active. DNS resolving globally. Systems recovering — CDN cache warming, application servers reconnecting to internal services.
